name: Search Account
description: Service task to search for accounts by accountId and/or customerId and return account details with customer roles

properties.label: Search Mode
properties.description: Choose which primary account lookup key to use.

properties.label: Account ID
properties.description: Primary account identifier to look up. Can be static or FEEL (e.g., =accountId, =order.accountId). Do NOT put customer ID here.

properties.label: Account ID
properties.description: Optional account ID filter in flexible mode.

properties.label: Legacy Account ID Alias
properties.description: Backward compatibility only. This maps to account lookup exactly like Account ID. Prefer using Account ID above.

properties.label: Legacy Account ID Alias
properties.description: Optional legacy alias in flexible mode.

properties.label: Account Number
properties.description: Exact or partial account number (e.g., SA-1001-NDL or 1001). Used for account lookup.

properties.label: Account Number
properties.description: Optional account number filter in flexible mode.

properties.label: Customer ID
properties.description: Customer identifier used to filter account relationships/roles. Do NOT put account ID here. Can be static or FEEL (e.g., =customerId, =payload.customerId).

properties.label: Customer ID
properties.description: Optional customer filter in flexible mode.

properties.label: Account Search Output
properties.description: Process variable to store the complete account search response (status, accounts, counts, convenience fields)
